name: Ridgekick
effect: Short widening Earth wedge, 20 Q4 once per enemy, with bounded push of ordinary targets. No boss displacement.

name: Rampart Turn
effect: One short angled ridge redirects an ordinary walking enemy into a visible side lane, then crumbles for 20 Q4. No boss displacement or player-trapping collision; one ridge maximum.

name: Lens Dart
effect: Narrow Water bead splits into two outward rays only on its first target impact: initial 16 Q4, secondary 8 Q4. Initial target cannot be hit again; rays respect walls.

name: Prism Wake
effect: One short-lived visible line splits the next eligible ordinary hostile shot into two harmless outward droplets, then ends. Endpoint Water burst is 24 Q4; one line and one consumed shot, no recycling.

name: Ember Hush
effect: One visible warm mark lengthens an ordinary enemy's next attack windup, then pops for 16 Q4 Fire. Boss telegraphs are not retimed; one mark and finite expiry.

name: Bellows Ring
effect: Visible expanding Fire annulus with an empty safe center, 24 Q4 once per target at its edge. One bounded ring; respects obstacles.

name: Sideguard
effect: Brace a narrow flank for one ordinary melee hit and reply with a 16 Q4 Earth swipe. Front and rear remain exposed; no general invulnerability.

name: Vault Step
effect: Move a narrow guard to one of two explicitly selected side positions, producing a 24 Q4 lateral wave after interception. One eligible hit; visible vulnerable sides remain.

name: Pinch Window
effect: Catch one marked ordinary melee strike in a narrow frontal arc and reply with a 24 Q4 Metal pin. Clear startup, no instant universal parry; boss windows remain unchanged.

name: Shear Gate
effect: Place two visible facing blades for one short crossing window; crossing target receives 24 Q4 once. One gate maximum and bounded lifetime; existing boss vulnerability rules apply.

name: Sapling Feint
effect: One brief grounded decoy diverts one eligible ordinary enemy approach, then folds. No boss taunt, player teleport or invulnerability.

name: Canopy Exchange
effect: Two short-lived decoys with a visible connecting line redirect one eligible approach toward the safer endpoint. A 16 Q4 Wood snap only after activation; no teleport or invulnerability.

name: Rill Fork
effect: Short Y-shaped Water fork, 12 Q4 per branch with one hit cap per target and a small slowing effect. Bounded segments respect walls; no player pull.

name: Veil Curl
effect: Clearly drawn Water crescent with a gap catches side approaches for 24 Q4 once. Escape lane remains open, walls block the curl and the player is never pulled.

name: Warm Echo
effect: Mark one visible target for the next ordinary weapon hit, triggering one delayed 16 Q4 Fire follow-up. One mark and short expiry prevent stockpiling; no through-wall targeting.

name: Paired Echo
effect: Link two separately aimed target marks. Striking one triggers a weak follow-up on the other only with line of sight; total 24 Q4 budget, no chains, friendly fire or through-wall targeting.

name: Needle Bank
effect: One Metal spine with one wall ricochet and a visible reflection. Swept segments, 20 Q4 maximum once per target; no extra bounces.

name: Quill Return
effect: Three-spine fan retracts along the creature's current unobstructed lane. Outbound and return share a 24 Q4 per-target budget; at most three bounded objects and no through-wall return.

name: Warm Thread
effect: Draw a 40px ground thread after an 8-update warning; first crossing ends it. No through-wall segments.

name: Coil Clamp
effect: Two hooked arcs close on a 32px pocket; a target is hit once across both arcs. The player can walk through.

name: Crown Interval
effect: Show three short spokes, then activate them in order; share a 32Q4 target budget across the whole cast. Gap remains visibly safe.

name: Heel Knock
effect: A narrow 22px stomp cone interrupts eligible ordinary foes; no boss displacement or terrain mutation.

name: Brace Reply
effect: Visible frontal bracing arc catches one eligible ordinary contact attack, then replies; expiry gives no damage and no invulnerability.

name: Archfall
effect: A visible overhead arch lands in a wide 44px frontal crescent after its warning. No temporary solid wall, crush or player push.
